description: This file is a reducer function for initializing the state of SQL Lab in the Superset frontend. It handles loading state from backend, local storage, and manages query editors, tables, and tab history.

methods.name: dedupeTabHistory
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from tab history, keeping only the last occurrence of each tab ID.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Initializes the SQL Lab state by merging backend, local storage, and default data, setting up query editors, tables, and tab history.
